answer: The strongest single control I know for this is command-line usage pattern fingerprint, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Faking 604 identities means 604 fresh proofs and 71876 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. One dawn of signal, one pulse of cost, one vault of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
